and JOHN/JANE DOES 1-6,

DECLARATION OF MARVELLE J. BALLENTINE IN SUPPORT OF PLAINTIFF'S
MOTION FOR AN ORDER DIRECTING COMPLETION OF THE RULE 26(f)
CONFERENCE AND SUBMISSION OF A DISCOVERY PLAN
1, Marvelle J. Ballentine, declare as follows:
I am the Plaintiff in this action. I proceed pro se. I have personal knowledge of the
facts stated here.
2.
I make this declaration to establish the history of the parties' Rule 26(f) planning
process through the date of execution and to authenticate Exhibits A, B, C-1, and C-2.
On October 16, 2026, I transmitted by electronic mail to Jesse Beringer and
Hillary Dang of Orrick, Herrington & Sutcliffe LLP, counsel for Defendant Meta Platforms, Inc.,
and to Padraic K. Keane of Jordan Coyne LLP, counsel for Defendants National Center for Missing
& Exploited Children and Katie Hall, the following documents: (a) Plaintiff's Rule 26(f)(2)
Written Proposal and Proposed Discovery Plan Directed to Defendant Meta Platforms, Inc.; (b)
1

the same, Directed to Defendant National Center for Missing & Exploited Children; (c) the same,
Directed to Defendant Katie Hall, Individually; and (d) a common agenda titled "Rule 26(f)
Conference by Written Exchange — Common Agenda for All Appearing Parties."
A true and complete copy of the common agenda transmitted on October 16, 2026
is attached as Exhibit A. It is unchanged from the version transmitted. Exhibit A identifies the
three proposals, their recipients, the requested response date, and the distinction between initiation
and completion of the parties' Rule 26(f) conference. Ex. A §§ I, II, IV, V. The three proposals are
available to the Court on request.
Exhibit A and each proposal requested a written response from each Defendant by
October 30, 2026. Ex. A § IV. That date was requested by me. It was not set by the Court. Each
proposal stated in its Section I that it was not a discovery request, not a certification that the Rule
26(f) conference had been completed, and not a representation that discovery had commenced.
Exhibit A stated that non-response, silence, or refusal would not be treated as completion. Ex. A §
IV.
A true and complete copy of the October 16, 2026 transmission email, showing
the date, recipients, and attachment names, is attached as Exhibit B.
On October 28, 2026, I sent electronic mail to Padraic K. Keane, counsel for
NCMEC and Hall, requesting the position of each of those Defendants on three subjects: whether
it intended to participate in the Rule 26(f) conference; whether it contended that any existing order
or other authority excused or postponed its Rule 26(f) obligations, and if so, what authority; and
whether it would oppose an order directing the parties to conduct the Rule 26(f) conference by a
date certain and submit a discovery plan identifying any unresolved disagreements. My email
stated that the October 30, 2026 response date remained unchanged. On the same date I sent a

separate electronic mail to Jesse Beringer and Hillary Dang, counsel for Meta, requesting Meta's
position on the same three subjects and stating the same response date. A true and complete copy
of my email to Mr. Keane, with the reply described in the next paragraph, is attached as Exhibit
C-1. A true and complete copy of my email to Meta's counsel is attached as Exhibit C-2.
On October 28, 2026, I received a reply by electronic mail from Padraic K.
Keane, counsel for NCMEC and Hall. The reply is included in Exhibit C-1. The reply stated that
Mr. Keane believed a Rule 26(f) conference was premature because Meta and his clients have
dispositive motions pending which, if granted in full, would dispose of all claims, because the
surviving claims are not yet known, and because I might seek leave to amend if the matter is
dismissed. The reply did not identify any order or other authority postponing the conference, did
not propose a date, and did not state whether NCMEC or Hall would oppose an order setting a
conference deadline. The reply did not state that it was sent on behalf of Meta.
As of the execution of this declaration, I have received no response from counsel
for Meta to the October 16, 2026 transmission or to my October 28, 2026 email.
10.
As of the execution of this declaration, no further exchange concerning the Rule
26(f) conference has occurred, and the Rule 26(f) conference has not been completed. On October
28, 2026, I reviewed the docket of this action through ECF 101. I located no order expressly
postponing the parties' Rule 26(f) conference.
11.
I remain prepared to complete the Rule 26(f) conference through the written
exchange described in Exhibit A, or through any format the Court directs, and to participate in
preparing the written report Rule 26(f)(2) requires.
I declare under penalty of perjury under the laws of the United States of America that the
foregoing is true and correct. 28 U.S.C. § 1746.
3

Executed on October 28, 2026.
Marvelle J. Ballentine
